mapper.update: update ingestion_task_item set stage_retry_count = stage_retry_count + case when #{item.leaseToken} is not null then 1 else 0 end, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = timestampadd(second, #{leaseSeconds}, current_timestamp(6)), stage_attempt = stage_attempt + 1, stage_started_at = coalesce(stage_started_at, current_timestamp(6)), next_action_at = null, stage = case when execution_stage in ('PARSE_SUBMIT', 'PARSE_WAIT', 'PARSE_PERSIST') then 'PARSE' when execution_stage = 'EMBED' then 'EMBED' when execution_stage = 'INDEX' then 'INDEX' else stage end, status = 'RUNNING', progress = greatest(progress, case when execution_stage in ('PARSE_SUBMIT', 'PARSE_WAIT', 'PARSE_PERSIST') then 20 when execution_stage = 'EMBED' then 55 when execution_stage = 'INDEX' then 75 else progress end), error_code = null, error_message = null, updated_at = current_timestamp(6), finished_at = null where id = #{item.id} and execution_epoch = #{item.executionEpoch} and execution_stage = #{item.executionStage} and stage_attempt = #{item.stageAttempt} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and (next_action_at is null or next_action_at <= current_timestamp(6)) and (lease_token is null or lease_until <= current_timestamp(6))

update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id set iti.stage = 'UPLOAD', iti.status = 'PENDING', iti.progress = 0, iti.execution_epoch = iti.execution_epoch + 1, iti.execution_stage = 'PARSE_SUBMIT', iti.stage_attempt = 0, iti.stage_retry_count = 0, iti.stage_started_at = null, iti.next_action_at = #{updatedAt}, iti.lease_token = null, iti.lease_until = null, iti.parse_request_snapshot = null, iti.parse_result_object_key = null, iti.embedding_result_object_key = null, iti.docling_request_id = #{nextDoclingRequestId}, iti.parse_attempt = #{nextParseAttempt}, iti.docling_job_id = null, iti.error_code = null, iti.error_message = null, iti.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, iti.finished_at = null where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and iti.parse_attempt = #{expectedParseAttempt}

update ingestion_task it join ( select task_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status in ('SUCCESS', 'SKIPPED') then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failure_count, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count from ingestion_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} group by task_id ) s on it.id = s.task_id set it.total_count = s.total_count, it.success_count = s.success_count, it.failure_count = s.failure_count, it.running_count = s.running_count, it.status = case when s.running_count > 0 then 'RUNNING' when s.pending_count > 0 then 'PENDING' when s.failure_count = s.total_count then 'FAILED' when s.success_count = s.total_count then 'SUCCESS' else 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' end, it.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, it.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, it.finished_at = case when s.running_count + s.pending_count > 0 then null else #{updatedAt} end where it.kb_id = #{kbId}
